paragraphs.en: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
paragraphs.zh: ArtCraft 是一款面向艺术家、设计师和电影制作者的意图化创作引擎。

paragraphs.en: Watch the two-minute ArtCraft demo on YouTube
paragraphs.zh: 在 YouTube 上观看两分钟的 ArtCraft 演示

paragraphs.en: Download ArtCraft · GitHub releases · Build from source
paragraphs.zh: 下载 ArtCraft · GitHub 发布版 · 从源码构建

paragraphs.en: ArtCraft is the IDE for interactive AI image and video creation. Compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, and choose the models that fit your work. Turn prompting into crafting with visual tools for precise, repeatable results.
paragraphs.zh: ArtCraft 是交互式 AI 图像与视频创作的集成开发环境（IDE）。 在 2D 中构图，在 3D 中布置场景，并选择适合你作品的模型。 借助可视化工具，把提示词创作变为精细打磨，获得精准且可复现的结果。

sents.en: ArtCraft is the IDE for interactive AI image and video creation.
sents.zh: ArtCraft 是交互式 AI 图像与视频创作的集成开发环境（IDE）。

sents.en: Compose in 2D, stage scenes in 3D, and choose the models that fit your work.
sents.zh: 在 2D 中构图，在 3D 中布置场景，并选择适合你作品的模型。

sents.en: Turn prompting into crafting with visual tools for precise, repeatable results.
sents.zh: 借助可视化工具，把提示词创作变为精细打磨，获得精准且可复现的结果。

paragraphs.en: Artists need control over composition, character identity, and camera placement. Build the scene before you generate it. Click any preview to view it at full size.
paragraphs.zh: 艺术家需要对构图、角色身份和镜头位置的掌控。 在生成场景之前先搭建好它。 点击任意预览图即可查看完整尺寸。

sents.en: Artists need control over composition, character identity, and camera placement.
sents.zh: 艺术家需要对构图、角色身份和镜头位置的掌控。

sents.en: Build the scene before you generate it.
sents.zh: 在生成场景之前先搭建好它。

sents.en: Click any preview to view it at full size.
sents.zh: 点击任意预览图即可查看完整尺寸。

paragraphs.en: More previews are coming for scene blocking, canvas editing, and scene relighting.
paragraphs.zh: 场景搭建、画布编辑和场景重打光功能的更多预览即将推出。

paragraphs.en: Start with a prompt when you want to explore an idea quickly, then use the canvas and scene tools to refine it.
paragraphs.zh: 当你想快速探索一个想法时，可以从提示词开始，然后使用画布和场景工具对其进行细化。

paragraphs.en: More previews are coming for image inpainting and image ingredients.
paragraphs.zh: 图像修复（image inpainting）和图像素材（image ingredients）的更多预览即将推出。

paragraphs.en: † Currently disabled. ‡ Restricted model; not currently available in the desktop app.
paragraphs.zh: † 目前已停用。‡ 受限模型；目前在桌面应用中不可用。

paragraphs.en: Additional provider integrations are planned for Kling, Google, Runway, and Luma. We're also interested in supporting existing subscriptions with aggregators such as OpenArt and Freepik.
paragraphs.zh: 额外的服务商集成已在计划中，包括 Kling、Google、Runway 和 Luma。 我们还有兴趣支持通过 OpenArt 和 Freepik 等聚合商的现有订阅。
